requirements.source_provenance: Each archive already independently audited against immutable original Git; this qualification rehashes source-bound actual native receipts and authenticated independent audit status, not full untrusted Git environment.
requirements.all_native_masks: For each source 2^n actual JUnit cases; no extra/missing/duplicate, skipped, xfailed or errors; native original baseline nonzero FAIL and final all PASS.
requirements.hash_binding: Every subset XML SHA256 must match original recorded per-mask receipt; independent auditor status exact; original archive SHA256 is inherited previously verified authority, tool download may unzip and not expose original ZIP bytes.
requirements.finite_law: For every ordered pair edit masks A,B: passing(A OR B) == passing(A) OR passing(B) on the same original protected case universe.
requirements.necessity: For every selected edit i, removing it from complete mask reduces protected passes.
requirements.original_author: Full unchanged original authored suite pass counts exactly 17 and 83; physical withdrawal reproduces baseline failing-case mask; exact restoration returns complete protected pass.
requirements.lean: Lean 4.24.0 independently checks the exact finite tables, pairwise join law and necessity propositions by kernel-evaluated decide.
requirements.comparators: Deer-flow equally informed exhaustive ledger tied the two-edit minimum; no exclusive selection or lifecycle advantage implied.
